87	    future calls to FlashInfer will use the best implementation.

89	    be significantly slower.
90	
91	    Tuning is performed only on rank 0. The resulting cache is broadcast
92	    to every rank so all ranks dispatch the same kernel tactic.
93	    """

95	    import tempfile

98	    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_world_group
